commit_message: Rebase ADR 0142 benchmark foundation onto ADR 0145
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0142 agent benchmark catalog
pr_body:
## Summary

- Re-integrate ADR 0142 on current main after ADR 0145 provider adapters.
- Add the versioned GameEngine Agent Benchmark, fail-closed evidence records, curated catalog scaffolding, and loopback installed-model discovery.
- Preserve ADR 0145 external provider adapter selection and launch snapshots; benchmark context is attached only to native-model runs.
- Preserve ADR 0152 work-claim comparison semantics without storing raw target keys.
- Keep compatible/unverified and benchmark-qualified model status distinct; no model weights are silently downloaded.

## Validation

- GameEngine Windows Validation
- Editor Visual Validation
